about: A status its ability cures, kept under Neutralizing Gas and taken into a place left empty: Twins Amy & Mimi in the Azalea Gym against a scratch copy of Paolo's Bugsy save with two Pokemon, a level-40 Houndoom given Neutralizing Gas in the running battle (set:) and a level-20 Goldeen given Water Veil, a burn and 1 HP. Both Protect; the burn faints the Goldeen at the turn's end, with no one left to take its place. Then the twins, knowing only Gastro Acid (teach:), suppress the Houndoom's gas, and the entry abilities run again: the fallen Goldeen has no ability, cures nothing, and no message names its empty place (before CheckStatusHealAbility asked for HP, 'Bad Egg cured its burn status with its Water Veil!' read party slot 6 and the copy back overwrote the opposing party). Houndoom's Flamethrower then ends the battle.

lines: Goldeen is hurt by its burn!
The effects of the neutralizing gas wore off!
